title: SmartThings: Matter codes, Z Wave DSK and the hub QR
description: SmartThings adds Matter devices by QR or the 11 or 21 digit code, Z Wave devices by QR or the first five DSK digits, and shares Matter devices with a code that differs from the label. Hubs are added by QR or Scan Nearby.
lede: SmartThings takes every kind of code and says which: Matter digits, the Z Wave PIN, the hub's own QR. Its share code is never the one on the sticker.

rows.text: Matter QR codes include an 11 or 21 digit setup code that can be used if the QR code cannot be scanned: Add, Add Device, then Enter under Enter setup code.
Scan the QR code on the device, or Add device manually and enter the first 5 digits of the DSK, the PIN. S2 unauthenticated devices join without a QR.
The device, More, Share with other services, Share device. SmartThings: this code is generated for the sharing process specifically and is different than the QR code physically on your device.
Devices, Add, Scan QR Code, or Scan Nearby. 2015 hubs use Add without QR Code. Where the Station's QR is printed is no longer on a Samsung page; owners point to the bottom of the unit.
